properties.name: supabase.db.url
properties.description: JDBC URL of the Supabase session pooler.

properties.name: inventory.low-stock-threshold
properties.description: Stock below this number counts as low stock.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Front-end origins allowed to call the API.

properties.name: inventory.reorder-target
properties.description: Stock level a reorder tries to reach.

properties.name: legacysupply.api-key
properties.description: LegacySupply API key. Keep it out of Git.

properties.name: legacysupply.session-renew-after-seconds
properties.description: Sign in again after this many seconds.

properties.name: supplier.send-pending-every-ms
properties.description: How often PENDING reorders are retried.

properties.name: supplier.track-deliveries-every-ms
properties.description: How often open supplier orders are checked.

properties.name: orders.backorder-max-wait-seconds
properties.description: A backorder not filled within this time is cancelled.

properties.name: orders.backorder-review-every-ms
properties.description: How often waiting backorders are re-checked.

properties.name: tiangge.poll-every-ms
properties.description: How often the Tiangge order feed is read.

properties.name: tiangge.heartbeat-every-seconds
properties.description: Heartbeat interval (at most what Tiangge asks for).
